title: Enterprise Support: outcome precision and disposition for missing-spend recognition
content:
Enterprise Support — outcome precision and disposition for missing-spend recognition.

## Decision basis

For missing-spend recognition: Floor missing eligible spending at zero, then round only the final eligible supported spending in USD quantity half up to six decimal places.

## Hypothetical case

For missing-spend recognition: A hypothetical nonnegative quantity of 1.2345675 rounds half up to 1.234568. A negative total is floored at zero before this quantity rounding.
